findings.explanation: No purchase order document exists in the case file at all, even though both INV-1005 and REC-1005 explicitly reference PO-1005, so the authorizing PO terms cannot be verified against the INR 59,000 payment.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice it references (INV-1005, dated 2026-07-21), an illogical sequence where the receipt predates the invoice it purports to satisfy.
